edges.description: Liver-specific deletion reproduces the cytosolic cluster assembly defect and the consequent loss of iron regulatory protein 1 control.
edges.limitations: The allele is a complete deletion, whereas human disease alleles are hypomorphic missense; complete loss is embryonic lethal, so the model cannot reproduce the human neurological or erythroid phenotype at the whole-organism level.

edges.description: Erythroid work in the mouse established that the partial-loss-of-function mechanism inhibits heme synthesis and that Abcb7 is required for haematopoiesis.
edges.limitations: Whether the inhibition of heme synthesis is direct remains unresolved in the model itself, which states only that it is direct or indirect.

evidence.reference_title: Mutation of a putative mitochondrial iron transporter gene (ABC7) in X-linked sideroblastic anemia and ataxia (XLSA/A).
evidence.snippet: These data indicate that ABC7 is the causal gene of XLSA/A and that XLSA/A is a mitochondrial disease caused by a mutation in the nuclear genome.

nodes.description: Conditional deletion of Abcb7 is lethal early in gestation and tissue-specific deletion impairs cytosolic cluster assembly, with the liver surviving and showing dysregulated iron metabolism.

The cerebellum is the tissue least able to tolerate the cytosolic cluster deficit. Mouse work shows Abcb7 is required for the development and function of numerous cell types, and in patients the imaging finding is selective cerebellar hypoplasia rather than a degenerative pattern, so the lesion is developmental, with atrophy appearing only in later life. Why the cerebellum in particular is affected is not established, and no patient or model cerebellar tissue study addresses it.

nodes.description: Iron delivered to the erythroblast mitochondrion cannot be used for heme, so it accumulates in a perinuclear ring, the ring sideroblast. Protoporphyrin accumulates upstream of the block and is raised in red cells, with zinc protoporphyrin predominating over free protoporphyrin, while body iron stores remain normal. The haemoglobin deficit that follows is mild and transfusion-independent.

nodes.description: A hemizygous germline missense variant in ABCB7 at Xq13. Every reported disease-associated allele is missense and they cluster in or near the transmembrane helices and the C-terminal nucleotide-binding domain: p.Ile400Met in the original kindred, p.Glu433Lys, p.Val411Leu, p.Glu208Asp and p.Gly682Ser. No truncating human allele is known, and conditional deletion is lethal in mice, so only hypomorphic alleles are compatible with life.

nodes.description: Iron regulatory protein 1 senses cellular iron by whether it holds a cytosolic iron-sulfur cluster. Without the exported precursor it cannot be loaded, so the cell misreads its own iron status and iron handling is dysregulated, as shown in mouse hepatocytes.

nodes.description: ABCB7 is a half-type ABC transporter of the mitochondrial inner membrane and the functional ortholog of yeast Atm1p. Human wild-type ABCB7 complements an ATM1 deletion in yeast while the patient alleles complement it poorly, which locates the defect in the transport function itself rather than in protein targeting or stability.

nodes.description: Pyridoxine was tried in two reported patients and did not work: the haemoglobin deficiency was refractory in one, and in the other oral vitamin B6 left haematocrit, mean cell volume, mean cell haemoglobin and the reticulocyte count unchanged. This is the clearest treatment contrast with ALAS2-related X-linked sideroblastic anemia, which is pyridoxine-responsive, and it follows from the mechanism: pyridoxal phosphate is the ALAS2 cofactor, and ALAS2 is not the defective step here.

nodes.description: ABCB7 is predicted to export a mitochondrially derived, sulfur-containing metabolite that the cytosolic iron-sulfur assembly pathway consumes. This is the rate-limiting step of the disease and the feature that separates it from every other inherited iron-sulfur disorder: the mitochondrial assembly machinery is intact and only the export step fails, so mitochondrial clients are spared while cytosolic ones are not.
